description: Export padding on separated UV islands (recording plan R1, R-090 P5/P6, decision 100): the authored islands mesh (four islands in one texture set: one on the tile's left border, gaps of 1 and 3 texels, one turned 30 degrees about 20 texels away). One fill: BaseColor and User0 (RGB16) field A, SpecularRoughness, Opacity (L8) and User1 (L32F) grey A, Height the height ramps, Normal normal-a. PNG 16: passthrough, infinite, and color, transparent and diffusion at dilation 0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 64; PNG 8 and OpenEXR 32f: infinite and the three at dilation 4; no dithering; every export step done twice in the session. Probes: L+A (specularroughness, opacity) and RGB+A (user0, opacity) under infinite and transparent 2 and 4, PNG 16 and OpenEXR 32f.
